prompt: This is one bounded read-only hook measurement. Spawn exactly one default child agent with fork_turns explicitly set to "none" and agent_type "default". Ask the child to independently choose a fresh unpredictable 16-character alphanumeric token, use no tools, and return exactly CHILD_TOKEN=<its token>. Do not suggest a token. You may use only spawn_agent and wait_agent, no shell, network, file, or other tools. Wait until the child is terminal. Then consume its FINAL_ANSWER notification and copy its exact CHILD_TOKEN line as your final answer. Do not guess a token and do not finish before that notification. This is a measurement fixture, not repository work.
